name: Dimitris Tsiodras - Proposition de la Commission et amendements
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 178/2002, (EC) No 401/2009, (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) No 2019/1021 of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the re-attribution of scientific and technical tasks and improving cooperation among Union agencies in the area of chemicals
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on a plan to share chemical safety work better between EU agencies. It says that when two agencies disagree on whether a chemical is dangerous, they must explain why, and the opinion that protects people's health most should win, especially for vulnerable groups. It also asks for more money and staff for the European Chemicals Agency, and for lower limits on harmful chemicals in waste by the end of 2027.

- Agencies that disagree on a chemical's danger must justify differences and favour the most protective view.
- The European Chemicals Agency gets more tasks; the Commission must check it has enough resources.
- The Commission must review and possibly lower limits for harmful chemicals in waste by 30 December 2027.
